newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney stock up on profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney stock up on profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Euro Disney were up more than four percent at midday on Monday, boosted by chairman Philippe Bourguignon's remarks confirming that the theme park operator was on track for a second annual profit.
The share was up 0.50 franc at 11.95 at 1015 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was up 0.17 percent.

Bourguignon said in an interview with daily Le Figaro that after showing a profit last year ahead of schedule, "we should logically do better this year." He said the peak summer season was "satisfying" while attendance during the low season had also increased. Euro Disney will report its results in November.

Analysts said the company appears to be firmly in the black but added that profit growth would be slow due to rising debt charges, which were suspended during a debt holiday as part of a restructuring to allow the company to get back on its feet.
Euro Disney reported a net profit of 114 million francs for 1994/95, including a 112 million franc extraordinary gain from the repurchase of convertible bonds.
Bourguignon said analysts estimate the company will show a net profit for 1995/96 of between 150 million and 220 million francs.
